paragraphs: Workday sells cloud software that runs human resources, finance and IT processes for an organization. Its human capital management line is a suite of HR products meant to work as one. The company says the software is built for organizations of all sizes. A packaged version is aimed at midsize businesses.

Inside the HR suite sit time tracking, absence, scheduling and payroll. Payroll is automated to pay workers accurately and in line with local rules. Recruiting covers the full talent acquisition lifecycle. The company argues the value comes from a single data model and one codeline rather than systems stitched together. It claims native localization for more than 175 countries.

More than 10,000 organizations use Workday, including a majority of the Fortune 500 by the company's own count. Customer stories on the site include Panera. Workday also cites Gartner recognition for cloud HCM suites.

quote.text: A unified AI platform built to serve your entire organization.
